{{Quote|What's that? Who's there?''"<br />"''Trooper KL-443 you have moved from your post. Do you need assistance?''"<br />"''Negative, I&mdash;|KL-443, just before Antilles and Skywalker break out of their cell|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 8">[[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]]</ref>}}
'''KL-443''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The trooper left his post in the detention bay to check out sounds coming from one of the cells. Two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], broke out of their cell in front of him. The latter, armed with a [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], attacked KL-443, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
